fusions.name: Sleeved Link
fusions.desc: Flicks a link at the first enemy it meets that deals 4 damage, with 50% more critical chance until something has bled.

fusions.name: Cut the Cord
fusions.desc: Lashes a bladed chain at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 18 damage, up to 1.4 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more for each one.

fusions.name: Edge Ready
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Opened Seam
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises 20% for 4 seconds and the enemy is [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
